request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).

agent.result_text:
I changed which member gets a pool's leftover cent, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

When a pool's pot is split by shares, each cut is rounded, so the cuts can add up to a little more or less than the pot. That difference (the remainder) used to go to the member with the largest share. It now goes to the member with the smallest cut above zero, and to the most recently added of them if several tie. Members with a zero cut don't receive it. If no member has a cut above zero, it goes to the last member who takes part in the split, meaning one who isn't retired, held, or outside their dates. That's how I read "the last member with a share" in the request.

Example: with a pot of 0.02 and shares of 33.33 / 33.33 / 33.34, the rounded cuts are 0.01 each, which is 0.01 over the pot. All three tie for smallest, so the 0.01 comes off the latest-added member: 0.01 / 0.01 / 0.00.

The cuts are only worked out in the front end, so the whole change is in `cuts()` in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/pools/pools.ts`, plus its doc comment. Nothing needed changing in the server, the stored data, or the audit file.

I tidied the wording of that doc comment after the passing run and didn't rerun the tests; the code itself is unchanged since then.
